summary: GLM-5.3-Flash reasons at max effort by default
compatibility: Answers carry a little more reasoning. To keep the previous behaviour, send chat_template_kwargs {"reasoning_effort": "high"} or set DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS='{"reasoning_effort":"high","clear_thinking":false}'.
details: The glm53-flash profile now sets reasoning_effort max (was high); clear_thinking stays false. GLM-5.3 (744B) keeps high.

At high the model quoted a looked-up row at once and confused near-duplicate record IDs in 516K-token documents. Default glm53-tp2 compose, temperature 0, record lookups: high 117/136 correct, max 136/136; on this task the answer grew by about 20 tokens.
